subject: chest
text: A chest at the end of the right path contains the Magic Mirror, which allows you to see invisible enemies.

evidence.quote:
At the end of this path is a chest containing a Magic Mirror. With it, you 
can see the invisible enemies here!

subject: chest
text: A chest on the left path contains Explosives.

evidence.quote:
Defeat the Desert Hags and take the Explosives from the
chest.

subject: chests
text: Two chests to the southwest contain Refreshers and Arrows.

evidence.quote:
Go southwest and open the two chests
for some Refreshers an Arrows.

subject: chest
text: A chest guarded by a Phanquid on the next floor contains Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
On the
next floor, head a little bit north to find some Heal Potions guarded by a 
Phanquid.

subject: chest
text: A chest behind a walkable wall contains Arrows.

evidence.quote:
It seems that you can walk into the wall here. Steal
the Arrows in the chest and return to the three-way fork.

subject: chest
text: Hitting the blue-tinged statue switch with the Steel Sword opens a wall revealing a chest containing arrows.

evidence.quote:
Use your Steel Sword to hit it. The wall
will open up to reveal a chest containing some arrows.

subject: chest
text: A chest guarded by a Freezer Crab on 3F contains Arrows.

evidence.quote:
This one leads to 3F. Begin here by 
moving right first. What do you know? MORE monsters! Stoney Roosts, Gathers,
and Freezer Crabs are some new faces you might see. A Freezer Crab guards a 
chest containing more Arrows.

subject: chest
text: Another chest further south contains more Arrows.

evidence.quote: Further south is another chest with some more Arrows.

subject: chests
text: Chests past the Stoney Roosts contain bombs and Arrows.

evidence.quote:
After 
clipping their wings, you can find some bombs and Arrows ahead.

subject: chests
object: 40 Arrows, 3 Refreshers, 3 Heal Potions, 3 Cure Potions, and the Noble Armor
text: Chests in the middle of 4F contain 40 Arrows, 3 Refreshers, 3 Heal Potions, 3 Cure Potions, and the Noble Armor.

evidence.quote:
There are multiple chests here. If you choose to open them all, you'll
find 40 Arrows, 3 Refreshers, 3 Heal Potions, 3 Cure Potions, and the Noble
Armor.

subject: chests
text: Two chests on 5F both contain bombs.

evidence.quote:
Return to 5F, but don't fall this
time. Begin by heading left. After getting rid of the monster, you can access
the two chests. To get the second one, you'll need to jump over the first. 
They both contain bombs.

subject: chest
text: A chest to the north past the Freezer Crab contains bombs.

evidence.quote:
Begin by heading north. Kill off the Freezer Crab and walk past it. Carefully
walk to the other end and pick up the bombs.

subject: chest
text: A chest reached by walking north and jumping from behind it contains Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
Therefore,
you'll have to walk north and jump at the chest from behind it. Open it for
some Cure Potions.

subject: cracked tile
text: Placing a bomb on top of the cracked tile blows a hole in the platform to fall down to lower floors.

evidence.quote:
See the cracked tile in the middle?
Place a bomb on top of it to blow a hole in the platform.

subject: chests
object: Arrows, Heal Potions, Cure Potions, and Knight Sword
text: Chests on B1 contain Arrows, Heal Potions, Cure Potions, and the Knight Sword.

evidence.quote:
When you hit B1, you will find yourself in an uncomfortable
situation. Haha, surrounded by enemies? Whether or not you choose to clear
them all out or not, don't forget about the chests. Snag some more Arrows,
Heal Potions, and Cure Potions. Also, remember to pick up the Knight Sword.

subject: Ice Golem
text: The key to defeating Ice Golem is Fire magic.

evidence.quote:
Boss Fight: Ice Golem ~
     =-------------------=
          Oh no; a giant made of ice! So scary. The key to this fight is Fire
          magic.

subject: chest
text: A chest after defeating the Ice Golem contains the River Coin.

evidence.quote:
Once the Ice Golem is melted, another crystal will appear. That's two for 
four. At least now, half of the world is peaceful once more. Aquaria should 
also be fixed. Phoebe will leave to check it out. Before you call it quits, 
pick up the River Coin from the chest.

subject: Spencer
text: Spencer gives you the Venus Key.

evidence.quote:
The other bridge leads to Spencer. As you
can see, he just realized that the ice had melted. After a bit of surprising
news, Spencer will hand you the Venus Key.

subject: chest
text: A chest reached by climbing the wall with Cat Claws contains Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
You
can climb the nearby wall with the Cat Claws. Drop down to the chest and pick
up some Cure Potions.

subject: inn
text: An old guy at the inn offers to sell Cure Potions for 25 GP each.

evidence.quote:
However, you could make a stop at the
inn. An old guy will offer to sell some Cure Potions for 25 GP each.

subject: Battlefield Ten
text: Clearing Battlefield Ten against Phanquids and Sphinxes awards the Exit Spell.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Ten ~
     =-------------=
          Monsters: Phanquid, Sphinx
          Prize: Exit Spell

subject: Battlefield Eleven
text: Clearing Battlefield Eleven against Gathers and Freezer Crabs awards 744 EXP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Eleven ~
     =----------------=
          Monsters: Gather, Freezer Crab
          Prize: 744 EXP

subject: chest
text: Bombing the wall to the left reveals a passage to a chest containing the Venus Shield.

evidence.quote:
Bomb the wall to your immediate left to make an
opening. Walk through this passage to a chest containing the shield that 
Spencer was talking about. Equip your Venus Shield with pride and return to
the stairs.

subject: chest
text: A chest on the other side of the room contains the Blizzard spell.

evidence.quote:
If you head over to the other side of the room, you will locate a 
Blizzard spell in a chest.

subject: statue
text: Push the statue two squares to the left, down until it hits the south wall, and left until it is stopped by a stone thingy.

evidence.quote:
Push it two squares to the left. Now
move it down until it hits the south wall and left until it's stopped by a
stone thingy.

subject: blue door
text: The blue door can be unlocked with the River Coin.

evidence.quote: With the River Coin, you can unlock the blue door.

subject: chest
text: A chest to the south contains Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
Pick up the Cure Potions from the chest to the
south.

subject: Battlefield Twelve
text: Clearing Battlefield Twelve against Jellies awards 900 GP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Twelve ~
     =----------------=
          Monsters: Jelly
          Prize: 900 GP

subject: Battlefield Thirteen
text: Clearing Battlefield Thirteen against Jellies and Sting Rats awards the Gemini Crest.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Thirteen ~
     =------------------=
          Monsters: Jelly, Sting Rat
          Prize: Gemini Crest

subject: Battlefield Fourteen
text: Clearing Battlefield Fourteen against Plant Mans awards 816 EXP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Fourteen ~
     =------------------=
          Monsters: Plant Man
          Prize: 816 EXP
